newer_changes_search: Web search (PIB, MoPNG, press) for 2025-2026 PMUY changes: 25 lakh additional connections approved for FY 2025-26 (target 10.6 crore), already in the content; ~10.41 crore connections released by Jan 2026. Press reports of that approval say eligibility was simplified to 'adult women from poor households based on submission of a Deprivation Declaration'. The targeted LPG refill subsidy of Rs 300 per 14.2 kg cylinder (up to 9 refills a year) was approved for FY 2025-26; I found no 2026-27 decision. No discontinuation found.

findings.note: Logic (SC/ST or is_bpl) is a partial check of the portal list; confidence 'uncertain' means a fail shows 'check with the office', which is correct. is_bpl covers AAY cards but also non-AAY BPL cards, which are not themselves a listed category (they would usually qualify via the 14-point / deprivation declaration). Reports of the 2025 approval say eligibility is now any poor household by Deprivation Declaration, which makes the list less decisive.
findings.suggestion: Keep 'uncertain'. When MoPNG publishes the revised criteria on pmuy.gov.in, re-snapshot and update the rule text.

findings.note: Amounts match the portal (Rs 1,600 / Rs 1,150; first refill and stove free). The Rs 300 per cylinder targeted refill subsidy (up to 9 refills) is not mentioned and has no source in the file.
findings.suggestion: Optional: add it with a PIB source, stating the financial year it applies to.

findings.note: 'these are being given out now' comes from the portal ('currently being released'); fine, and the advice to ask the distributor hedges it.
